# brig service stop

Stop a service

## Synopsis

```text
brig service stop NAME
```

## Description

Stop a service: shut its VM down, as [`brig stop`](brig-stop.md) does, or stop its controller on the host. Sandboxes keep their tokens.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-f, --force` | power the VM off immediately instead of shutting it down gracefully |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
